title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint: Follow-up for chronic kidney disease.

HPI: The patient is a 62-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up of his chronic kidney disease. He reports feeling generally well but notes some increased fatigue over the last month. He denies any new shortness of breath, significant edema, or changes in urinary output. He is compliant with his current medications and has been monitoring his blood pressure at home.

Medication List: Lisinopril 20mg, Furosemide 40mg, Sevelamer 800mg.

Exam: The patient appears in no acute distress. Vital signs are stable. Physical exam reveals normal skin turgor and no peripheral edema. Lungs are clear to auscultation bilaterally. Heart sounds are regular without murmurs.

Assessment: The patient has stable chronic kidney disease. Current laboratory values confirm he remains in stage 4 of the disease.

Plan: Continue current medication regimen. Order a repeat metabolic panel and phosphorus level in three months. Patient instructed to maintain a low-protein diet and follow up as scheduled.
